'''Grarnik Goodstitch''' is a [[goblin]] [[tailoring trainer]] located in the shop [[A Tailor to Cities]] in [[Booty Bay]] in the [[Stranglethorn Vale]]. He is on the top floor, in the middle of the town.

==Quotes==
;Gossip
I made a lot of the things you see in the store. What do you think? Answer carefully, your life may depend on it.
